verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is cost budgets, which let users configure alerts that fire on actual or forecasted spend (azure-docs-13). That is a narrow rule-to-notification mechanism, not general event-driven automation. Outage notifications (azure-docs-18) are a service-side feed rather than user-defined rules. Missing for 10: general event-routing or rule engines (e.g. event subscriptions, workflow or automation triggers), actions beyond notifications, programmatic or AI-driven rule definition, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
